briefdescription.para: Save current arena state as a checkpoint.

detaileddescription.para:
Save current arena state as a checkpoint
Opaque checkpoint pointer, or nullptr on failure
Creates a checkpoint of the current arena state. The checkpoint can later be used with restore() to rollback all allocations made after the checkpoint. This is useful for transactional or scoped allocations.
The checkpoint is allocated separately (not from the arena) and must be freed by restore(). If you don't call restore(), you leak the checkpoint (but not the arena memory).

Returns nullptr if:
Arena has no chunks
Checkpoint allocation fails
